## Rattlespike (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
NE Small undead  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0  


**Defense**


**AC** 13, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 24 (3d8)  
**Fort** +1, **Ref** +2, **Will** +3  
**DR** 5/bludgeoning; **Immune** cold, undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +5 (1d4+2), slam +5 (1d3+2)  
**Ranged** bone spike +4 (1d3+2)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 13, Con—, Int—, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 14  


**Special Abilities**


**Bone Spikes (Ex)** A rattlespike is covered in razor-sharp, protruding bone spikes from which it gets its name. Its slam attack deals both piercing and bludgeoning damage. A rattlespike can launch one of its spikes as a ranged attack with a range of 20 feet. A creature that strikes a rattlespike with a natural weapon or attempts to grapple it sustains 1d6 piercing damage. Succeeding at a DC 13 Reflex save halves the damage. Save DC is Constitution-based and includes a +2 racial bonus.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any Organization solitary, pair, or pack (3-9)  
**Treasure** none
